# Dojo rich input integration

Upstream CUA revision `88aff7e5424e9ed45b93ded85eb4111472ca5190`, MIT license and notices in `vendor/cua/crates/cua-cursor-motion/LICENSE` and the import ledger.

`vendor/niri/src/agent_input/motion.rs` now calls the retained `cua-cursor-motion::ease::min_jerk` implementation from upstream `libs/cua-driver/rust/crates/cua-cursor-motion/src/ease.rs`. The imported crate and upstream golden motion fixtures stay unchanged. Dojo retains its bounded 120–550 ms duration and local Hermite velocity correction on redirection. Wait still means full arrival with zero final velocity; CUA's optional first-arrival versus visual settling, arc paths and effects have not been enabled. Those require separate live motion acceptance before changing the existing contract. Existing motion tests cover bounded duration, endpoints and redirected position/velocity.

The capture contract and Rust service adopt the action semantics described in upstream `libs/python/agent/cua_agent/responses.py`, `computers/base.py`, and `agent.py` input dispatch: printable physical text, bounded key hold, image-relative drag and execute→observe. They are local Rust implementations, not literal copied Python source. Tests exercise mapping, capture one-use authority, character shift transitions and held input cleanup. Pending safety checks are never automatically acknowledged.

Deliberate limitations: physical text requires an explicitly plain `us` XKB layout with no variants, custom file, options, model, rules, lock/group state or other held keys. Printable ASCII has a 512-byte maximum; Unicode, newlines and other control characters are refused, and there is no clipboard fallback. Key holds last 1–1000 ms and release inside the admitted operation. Drag has 1–16 waypoints within the delivered image, maps inside the owning capture authority, and checks the same mapped window before each motion delivery. Cross-window drag and persistent cross-call key/button holds are not advertised. Each action carries the capture's ownership revision and exact rendered window rectangle, output geometry/scale/transform, and compositor PID/start generation. The compositor compares those values before every command and every animation frame. Window movement or resizing, output changes and unavailable render geometry cancel held input even when the pointer stays over the same root. Releases stay deliverable for cleanup while reporting interruption; reset clears the remaining seat state.

`observe_after` requests one fresh observation after the attempt. Capture failure is reported alongside the retained action receipt; input is never replayed. The MCP adapter extracts the fresh image as an image block. Pacing waits run in the service worker, never the compositor event loop.
